plan: performance budgets: list screens and the JavaScript every page loads

phases.name: a list screen sends the same number of queries for a full page as for one row
phases.note: Covers members, invitations and the audit log. 2026-11-19: it caught the members screen loading each member's roles one at a time (23 queries for 10 rows against 15 for 2); OrganizationMemberResource::scopedQuery() now eager-loads user.roles, which also fixes the API index.

phases.name: the app entry and its static imports stay under 190 000 gzipped bytes
phases.note: 2026-11-19: 181 437 bytes across 10 chunks. The budget is the measured size plus about 5 %, so a new heavy import on the entry path trips it.

phases.name: stretch: the app entry and its static imports fit in 90 000 gzipped bytes
phases.note: Half the 2026-11-19 measurement. Reaching it means moving code off the entry path into the page chunks that need it.
